LanguageData.BackupGeneratorChemfuel.label: Backup generator (chemfuel)
LanguageData.BackupGeneratorChemfuel.description: Emergency power kicks in when battery reserves fall below a set minimum (default: 200 Wd). Generator kicks off when reserves exceed a set maximum (default: 1000 Wd). Consumes little fuel when idle.
